summary: Independent review found no blocking or important issues. The TMT channel-to-sample map (126=CTR-CPZ, 127=CPZ-42d, 128=CTR-EAE, 129=EAE-16d, 130=EAE-32d) contradicts the paper Methods and PRIDE protocol prose, but is supported by the deposited sample sheet, Supplementary Data 1, the PD export ratio structure, a cuprizone biological signature in 127/126, and correlation with the independent per-animal label-free data. All 97 deposited RAW files are claimed exactly once across the TMT (63) and label-free (34) SDRFs. Only minor findings remain.

spec_compliance.evidence: 315 rows x 36 columns, uniform row width; templates declared ms-proteomics v1.1.0 + vertebrates v1.1.0 (both 'latest' in templates.yaml, independently judged correct for mouse tissue TMT DDA); sdrf version v1.1.0; 315 unique assay names; no duplicate (data file, label) pairs; 5 labels x 63 files; fraction identifiers are integers (1-53 for the fractionated set, 1 for unfractionated runs, per template guidance); modification parameters use NT/AC/TA|PP/MT syntax; characteristics[pooled sample] SN= values match the template pattern ^(not pooled|pooled|SN=.+(;SN=.+)*)$; sdrf-tools structure: 'Structure OK'.

source_evidence.evidence: Re-fetched PRIDE project/files (projectAccessions = {PXD002318}), sample sheet, both PD exports and Europe PMC PMC8010076 full text + supplementary files (title matches). Organism, female sex, C57BL/6, frontal cortex, 8-week-old induction, CPZ 0.2% for 6 weeks, EAE sacrifice on p.i. days 16 and 32, PD 1.4.1.14 tolerances and modifications, TCEP, DDA on an LTQ-Orbitrap Velos Pro and 53 fractions plus the unfractionated sample all match the cited text. Channel map: the sheet and Supplementary Data 1 give 126=CTR-CPZ, 127=CPZ, 128=CTR-EAE, 129=EAE-16d, 130=EAE-32d. The paper Methods and PRIDE prose give a different map, refuted as follows. (1) The PD ratios 127/126, 129/128 and 130/128 share denominator 128, which only fits 128 = CTR-EAE; under the prose map 128 would be EAE-16d. (2) In median-normalised 127/126, myelin proteins fall (MOBP 0.48, Opalin 0.43, MOG 0.57, MBP 0.67) and gliosis/microglia markers rise (Gpnmb 12.2, C1qb 5.3, Gfap 2.6), the cuprizone signature with CPZ in the numerator. (3) The published Supplementary Data 1 'CPZ42d/EAE16d/EAE32d TMT' values equal median-normalised PD 127/126, 129/128 and 130/128 (median absolute difference below 0.004). (4) Against independent per-animal label-free ratios (n=1871), 127/126 vs LF CPZ r=0.70 (vs LF EAE about 0), 129/128 vs LF EAE-16d r=0.58 (vs EAE-32d 0.43), and 130/128 vs LF EAE-32d r=0.56 (vs EAE-16d 0.37). Pool membership per channel matches the sheet exactly, including the EAE-32d pool A4..F4 and the 6-animal CTR-EAE pool.

file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE lists 102 files, 97 of them RAW. The TMT SDRF has 63 unique RAW files, each with 5 rows (TMT126-130); the sibling label-free SDRF has 34. The two sets don't overlap, every RAW file is covered and there are no extras. MP1_3 maps to fraction 1, MP7_9 to 2 and MP10..MP60 to 3..53, matching the sheet's 'Combined mixed-mode fractions'/'Mixed-mode fraction N'. MP4_6 ('Discarded') is correctly absent from PRIDE and the SDRF. The 10 TOP7/TOP10 runs match the sheet's 'Unfractioned sample, parameters optimization 1..10'. No non-raw files are listed.

design_consistency.evidence: 5 pooled conditions (CTR-CPZ n=5, CPZ-42d n=5, CTR-EAE n=6, EAE-16d n=6, EAE-32d n=6 animals) in one TMT6plex mix; TMT131 unused, consistent with the 1:1:1:1:1 mix. Factor values (disease plus sampling time) separate all 5 conditions: the two 'normal' controls differ by sampling time (42 day vs not available). Technical replicate 1 is the 53-fraction set; technical replicates 2-11 are the 10 unfractionated optimisation re-injections. Sampling time for CTR-EAE is 'not available' because the paper (p.i. day 32) and the sheet (36 days) conflict. The paper's CTR-EAE N=5 conflicts with the sheet's 6 animals, but 6 matches the PRIDE prose 'pool of N=6' and the 6 label-free CTR-EAE RAW files.

omission_safety.evidence: No value is more specific than its evidence: strain C57BL/6 (not a sub-strain), disease terms broad or exact, alkylation reagent 'not available' (iodoacetamide appears only in the label-free digestion section; TMT only cites the kit manual), sampling time 'not available' where sources conflict, developmental stage 'adult' supported by 8-week-old induction plus 16-42 days. Dissociation method and collision energy are omitted rather than single-valued, which is safe because fraction runs used back-to-back CID (NCE 35) and HCD (NCE 40), confirmed in the RAW method header. Material evidence the producer could have omitted (the paper/PRIDE prose channel map) is disclosed in the manifest limitations.

findings.message: Each channel is a pool of 5-6 animals but biological replicate is '1'. The spec README says 'For pooled samples, use pooled for biological replicate'.
findings.evidence: spec README.adoc 'Encoding sample technical and biological replicates'; the sample-metadata validator accepts both integer and 'pooled'. Correction criterion: consider 'pooled', or keep 1 and rely on characteristics[pooled sample].

findings.message: 'demyelinating disease' (MONDO:0002562) is accurate but broad. Cuprizone causes CNS demyelination (corpus callosum histology), so 'demyelinating disease of central nervous system' (MONDO:0020800) is a closer, still-supported term.
findings.evidence: OLS4 exact search; paper Methods 'Cuprizone' and Supplementary Fig. 1.

findings.message: The fractionated runs used documented back-to-back CID (ion trap, NCE 35) plus HCD (Orbitrap, NCE 40). If multi-valued annotation is acceptable, these could be added for the fraction rows. Omitting them is safe.
